title: Skin Care for Visakhapatnam Weather: A Routine for Humid Summers, Sea Breeze and Cyclone-Season Rains
ex: Humid most of the year, with strong coastal sun, two monsoons and a mild winter: a simple skin care routine for people living in Vizag.
rt: Skin Care for Visakhapatnam Weather: Vizag Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Visakhapatnam weather: light layers for humid Vizag summers, beach and salt care, monsoon and cyclone-season tips and a mild-winter routine.
quick: Vizag is warm and humid for most of the year, with strong coastal sun, two monsoon seasons and a short, mild winter. A gentle face wash, a light gel or lotion moisturiser, daily broad-spectrum sunscreen and a thin night cream, a little more in December to February, suit most skin.
facts: Visakhapatnam is on the Bay of Bengal coast with the Eastern Ghats behind it
March to June is hot and humid
Rain comes in both the southwest and northeast monsoons
December to February is mild and pleasant
